frontText:
Move one character left. Which key?

```
cat
 ●
←┘
```

Move down one line. Which key?

```
one
 ●
 ↓
two
```

Move up one line. Which key?

```
one
 ↑
 ●
two
```

Move one character right. Which key?

```
cat
 ●
 └→
```

Jump to the next word start. Which key?

```
const userName
●─────→
```

Jump to the previous word start. Which key?

```
const userName
←─────●
```

Jump straight to the first line.

```
1    ← target
│
●    line 500
│
EOF
```

Jump straight to the last line.

```
1    ●
│
│
EOF  ← target
```

Jump straight to line 42.

```
 41
→42  target
 43
```

Scroll half a screen down.

```
┌────────────┐
│  viewport  │
└────────────┘
      ↓ ½
```

Scroll half a screen up.

```
      ↑ ½
┌────────────┐
│  viewport  │
└────────────┘
```

Jump to the next whitespace-separated **WORD**, skipping the punctuation inside `foo.bar`.

```
foo.bar   baz
●─────────→
```

Jump back to the previous whitespace-separated **WORD**.

```
foo.bar   baz
←─────────●
```

Use Command-line mode to jump to line 32.

```
 31
→32  target
 33
```

Use Command-line mode to jump to the last line.

```
1
│
│
EOF  ← target
```

Move down continuously using keyboard repeat. Which key should you hold?

```
● line 1
│
│
▼ line 4
```
Open `src/utils/format.js` in the current Vim window. Full or abbreviated command names are accepted.
Change Vim's working directory to `~/project` so relative paths in commands such as `:edit src/main.py` start there.

Open a shell in a full-width terminal split at the bottom of Vim. Full or abbreviated command names are accepted.

```
┌─────────────────┐
│ code            │
├─────────────────┤
│ terminal        │
└─────────────────┘
```

With only your code and a terminal split open in Vim, switch from the terminal back to your code.

```
┌─────────────────┐
│ code  ← target  │
├─────────────────┤
│ terminal  ●     │
└─────────────────┘
```

Open a shell in a full-height terminal split on the right side of Vim. Full or abbreviated command names are accepted.

```
┌────────┬──────────┐
│ code   │ terminal │
│        │          │
└────────┴──────────┘
```
